task.title: Merge gate never codegen-checks the release-only shell block
task.description: Surfaced reviewing WB-01M0DT46WN (2026-08-20): the gate's cargo build -p three_rings line is a DEBUG build, and the shell's embedded-server setup block (src-tauri/src/lib.rs) is #[cfg(not(debug_assertions))] — so its call sites (now including the /__loading splash navigation, load-bearing for every desktop launch) are never codegen-checked by CI; only a local cargo tauri build exercises them. clippy --all-targets covers the splash module itself via its cfg(test) arm, but not the release-only call sites. Fix shape: add a release-profile codegen line for three_rings to validate.yml (cost: one extra rustc pass) or record the gap explicitly in CLAUDE.md's gate list.
